owner_and_capability: Owner and workflow compositions stop building other owners' compositions (ADR 0059 point 6, decision B of #4004): the root builds those owners and passes them as dependencies. First slice: the grade transition workflow (workflows/gradetransition/compose) receives School Structure and Student Presence from the root (api.NewGradeTransitionOwners). Second slice: the parent portal workflow (workflows/parentportal/compose) receives the Audit Platform's guardian change trail from the root (api.ParentGuardianChanges). Third slice: the staff offboarding workflow (workflows/staffoffboarding/compose) receives School Membership, its retirement, Timetable's offboarding and Student Presence's supervision lock from the root (api.NewStaffOffboardingOwners); its Workforce offboarding stays in the composition because its deletion audit carries models/audit rows (family A). Fourth slice: the student deletion workflow (workflows/studentdeletion/compose) receives School Structure, the Communication conversation store, Enrollment, Student Presence's attendance, visit and consent counts, the Appointments recipient count and the Identity & Access guardian invitation count from the root (api.NewStudentDeletionOwners); its audit appender and the timetable projection count stay (family A, implementation role). Fifth slice: the request review composition (modules/requestreview/compose) receives the School Structure groups and the Audit Platform's correction query from the root; its Care Plan review queries stay, because their adapters name Care Plan composition types.
affected_tables: None: the same owners run the same statements; only the package that constructs them moves.
atomic_cutover: One PR: the workflow composition's Dependencies get Structure and Presence (required), the root builds them with the same constructors, the same database and the same no-op observers the composition used, and the two keys leave legacy.jsonl. Second PR: the parent portal Dependencies get GuardianChanges, which the root and every suite construction bind to the same NewGuardianChangeLog the composition used, and the key leaves legacy.jsonl. Third PR: the staff offboarding Dependencies get Membership, Retirement, Timetable and LockSupervision instead of Employment; the root builds them with the same constructors and no-op observers, and three keys leave legacy.jsonl. Fourth PR: the student deletion Dependencies get Owners (all required); the root builds them with the same constructors and no-op observers, and six keys leave legacy.jsonl. Fifth PR: NewStudentDirectory takes the School Structure query and NewCorrectionLog the correction query; the root builds both with the same constructors and observers, and two keys leave legacy.jsonl.
